notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes: Steam invites are back again. Server list wont work until I add a new lobby system.

notes.title: Multiplayer Invites
notes.notes: If you have problems with inviting your friends from steam, use TAB key to invite your friends. It also added to controls graffities in level 0.

notes.title: Public Lobbies Disabled
notes.notes: Public lobbies disabled, you can still play with your friends. New lobby creator will be added to game with public option soon.

notes.title: Patch 14.3
notes.notes:
-Level 37.1 not dying void bug fixed
-Level ! monsters are now slower and there is no longer a crouch obstacle so it should be easier now.
-Level 188 doors are now much lighter and easy to open.
-Level 4 bug which causes when you slip in parkour you dont die is fixed.

notes.title: Patch 14.2
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug in level 3 causes hounds stuck on door and make it impossible to enter the room.
-Fixed a bug causes the faceling in level 4 bugging in doors.

notes.title: Patch 14.2
notes.notes: -Fixed a bug in Level 4 that causes unopenable doors open when you jump near them.

notes.title: Update 14.1
notes.notes: Update re-released, level 37.1 spawn bug fixed.

notes.title: Update 14 "The Deep End"
notes.notes:
-Dark sector of Poolrooms removed, now you will teleport into level 37.1 instead.
-New entity in Level 37.1.
-Objectives in level 37.1.
-Water walking sound effects(yeah now it isnt making noises like you are still walking on concrete).
-Fixed a bug in level 2 occurs when you take left way after generator causes you to die.

notes.title: Upcoming Level 37.1 "The Deep End" Update (Release 08.04.2023)
notes.notes:
-Added keybindings for flaslight, whistle, crouch and vhs overlay.
-Dark sector of Poolrooms removed, now you will teleport into level 37.1 instead.
-New entity in Level 37.1.
-Objectives in level 37.1.
-Water walking sound effects(yeah now it isnt making noises like you are still walking on concrete)

notes.title: Patch 13.1
notes.notes:
-The entity in level 4 can no longer kill you from distance.
-Several multiplayer fixes.

notes.title: Update 13
notes.notes:
-Level 1 is much bigger now, and key card spawn point is randomized.
-Level 2 roadblock is now passable without vent.
-Level 1-2 entrance fixed.

notes.title: Patch 12.5 Dead Update
notes.notes:
-When you die, you will turn into a mini wanderer, but you cant interact with doors, buttons and entities. You can only walk around.
-Level 1 is a bit bigger now.
-Doors on level 4 fixed, they are no longer openable by clients
-The boss now can kill other players after killing somebody, as it should be
-Mini wanderers only visible to owner bug is fixed

notes.title: Patch 12.2
notes.notes:
-Entities killing from distance in level 3 fixed.
-Now you only need keycard(which you will find instead of key) to open the door and escape in level 1.

notes.title: Patch 12.2
notes.notes: Fixed a bug causes Level 1-2 change kills you instead of level change.

notes.title: Patch 12.1
notes.notes:
Minor level fun changes 
Minor performance and bug fixes.

notes.title: Chinese, Russian ant Turkish language support.

notes.title: Patch 10.6
notes.notes: Fixed a bug causes to falling in void without level restart, in level 0 and level 2.

notes.notes:
-Bacteria model and animations updated.

notes.title: Patch 9.2
notes.notes:
-Level 0 visuals and lighting changed a bit.

notes.title: Update 9 "Electrical Station" Rework
notes.notes:
-Level 3 Rework.
-New entity: Hound
-Faster entities.
-Performance and network code optimizations.
-Pressing U now also close fish-eye lens effect.

notes.title: Upcoming Level 3 Rework
notes.notes:
Upcoming Level 3 Rework Features, will release tomorrow:
-Level layout made from scratch
-Blast gates that needed to be disabled
-Vents
-New objectives.

notes.title: Update 9: Performance Update
notes.notes:
-Lighting system changed, you can expect +%50 performance in level 0, level 1 and level Fun.
-Only one player enough for level change.

notes.title: Update 8.2

notes.title: Update 8.1
notes.notes:

-Camera is now smoother

notes.title: Update 8
notes.notes:
-Added "The Boss" into level 4 offices section(part where you find keycard)
-Offices section are now a bit bigger, and keycard location changed into 4 random different places.
-New fish-eye lens which should be much less nauseating.
-New camera shake, no longer a static left/right tilting camera.

notes.title: Patch 7.5
notes.notes:

-Added invisible walls to Level 37 windows.(You cant suicide anymore)

notes.title: Update 6
notes.notes:
-New main menu added.

-Crouch speed increased from 150 to 250
-Walk speed increased from 100 to 250 (dont ask why walk speed was slower than crouching)
